title: MemOVCD: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Cross-Temporal Memory Reasoning and Global-Local Adaptive Rectification
abstract: arXiv:2604.26774v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) seeks to identify semantic changes in bi-temporal remote sensing imagery with text-specified target categories. Representative foundation-model pipelines decode the two timestamps independently before comparing their predictions, leaving cross-temporal evidence unavailable to semantic decoding. Moreover, current patch-wise inference can undermine global semantic continuity, yielding fragmented predictions. To address these limitations, we put forward MemOVCD, a training-free framework which reformulates OVCD as cross-temporal memory-conditioned inference. Specifically, MemOVCD casts bi-temporal analysis as a bidirectional two-frame tracking problem and exploits the memory mechanism of video SAM to propagate semantic candidate regions across timestamps. translated_title: MemOVCD：基于跨时相记忆推理与全局-局部自适应校正的无训练开放词汇变化检测
translated_abstract: 开放词汇变化检测旨在利用文本指定的目标类别，在双时相遥感影像中识别语义变化。代表性的基础模型流水线在比较预测结果之前会对两个时相进行独立解码，导致语义解码无法获取跨时相证据。此外，当前的逐块推理方式可能破坏全局语义连续性，产生碎片化的预测结果。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了MemOVCD，这是一个无需训练的框架，它将开放词汇变化检测重新表述为跨时相记忆条件下的推理任务。具体而言，MemOVCD将双时相分析转化为双向双帧跟踪问题，并利用视频SAM的记忆机制在时相之间传播语义候选区域，将这些区域的特征池化并平均为局部示例标记。随后，通过一个共享记忆（其原型数量由…确定）——（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的开放词汇变化检测框架MemOVCD，通过将双时相分析建模为跨时相记忆条件推理并引入全局-局部自适应校正机制，解决了现有方法跨时相证据不可用和预测碎片化的问题。
en_tdlr: MemOVCD is a training-free open-vocabulary change detection framework that reformulates OVCD as cross-temporal memory-conditioned inference, leveraging video SAM's memory mechanism and global-local adaptive rectification to overcome unavailable cross-temporal evidence and fragmented predictions.
